description: Issue #145 段3 (ADR adr-scope-derivation.md section 7), the half that makes the detection worth having: the L3 question rides the EXISTING open-question gate, so the plan that carries it dispatches NOBODY. #240 demands a unit test while declaring only a shell script — an ecosystem L1 has no rule for, so no test path reaches its scope.allow — and the run stops before the first send. #241 would have succeeded (the scenario has both workers completing with verify 0); the refusal comes from the plan, not from the world, which is exactly why a false positive here is cheap: `commandmate send` is called ZERO times, so no worker's run is spent, and the operator re-plans after editing the body — the same move a true positive asks for. `warning` alone could not do this: dispatch never reads plan.status.

blocking_details_include: #240: Acceptance asks for a test but no test path is among the affected files; name it in the issue body, or say no new test is needed. Criterion: "新しい GATE 行を読む unit test を追加し、それが判定する"
summary_includes: Criterion: "新しい GATE 行を読む unit test を追加し、それが判定する"
